newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean miners killed, 13 buried in coal mine.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean miners killed, 13 buried in coal mine.

text.p: A roof collapse in a coal mine in eastern South Korea on Wednesday killed at least two people and left 13 miners missing, Yonhap News Agency reported.
It said the accident, at about noon (0300 GMT), happened at a mine about 200 kilometres (125 miles) east of Seoul.
The roof collapsed at a depth of 335 metres (yards) and about three kilometres from the entrance of the mine, Yonhap said.
The missing miners were buried under tons of rubble in near-freezing temperatures.
The mine is located in South Korea's main coal mining district of Kangwon Province.
